name: ingenus-mcp-bridge
description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Ingenus MCP server: read-only contract and SAP checks. Proof of concept on synthetic data.
long_description: A thin bridge with no tools of its own: it forwards Claude Desktop's requests to the central Ingenus MCP server, where the read-only tools and guidance live. It cannot change SAP or any file. Phase 1 v1 proof of concept by Psiog; synthetic data only.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: The Ingenus MCP server address. For the local test: http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp. A server on the network must use https://.
